title: 第十四章 博弈4000二合一第十五章 回归x奖励
content_zh:
，，！
王长乐收起卷轴，取出五件制式防爆铠甲，又拿出一瓶1星进化药剂，放在地上。
叶钟鸣对于王长乐，心中却有了更深的疑惑，他看得出王长乐说的都是真话。
但是在他的脑海里却没有半点关于这个人的记忆，不论前世还是今生，他都不认识这个人！
“我为什么要和你交易？一星进化药剂而已。”
夏蕾，小虎听着这话语，不由得有些目瞪口呆。
今天是怎么了，珍贵的进化药剂不仅成了交易的等价物，叶钟鸣还说‘而已’。
要知道，昨天晚上他们还看见，两伙人为了一瓶进化药剂，发生了剧烈的火并。
死伤几十人之多，现在却成了别人口中的“而已”
“别人说这话，我肯定不信，但叶老大说这个话，我信！
一星进化药剂，只是报酬的一部分，另外一部分—我会回答你我来自于哪里。”
王长乐哈哈一笑，脸色却很淡定。
他之所以拿出一星进化药剂，一是因为这进化药剂仅第一次使用有效，第二是这东西也不能带出世界！
一个对他已经无效，而且不能带出世界的进化药剂，自然价值大大降低了，所以他选择拿出来当做交易的筹码！
毕竟这进化药剂在前期还是很珍贵，算是一种不错的等价物，尤其是对于想要组建团队的人。
而对于叶钟鸣而言，他就是不折不扣的不稳定因素！
现在有这么一个了解的机会，叶钟鸣这种掌控欲和控制欲都爆棚的人，他猜想对方一定不会拒绝。
王长乐话说完后，叶钟鸣却陷入了沉默，空气一下子安静了下来。
十秒后。
“好，我可以和你交易，这次你又要什么？”

叶钟鸣向着梁初音点了点头，让她带着夏蕾小虎等人出去，场上只留了地黄丸和墨夜。
“我需要叶老大帮我炼制一件装备，用你的同质化强化的能力。
以这五套防爆服为蓝本，这是其他的材料。”
王长乐看着叶钟鸣屏退众人，立刻将一件件材料从印记空间中拿出，有恐羊的尖角，恐羊的一大块皮，以及10颗魔力结晶。
叶钟鸣看着王长乐接连不断的拿出材料，心中又是一沉，这么多材料在转瞬之间出现，这是空间装备！
他心头一沉，这人似乎总能在自己之前获得对应的道具，他刚获得空间道具，这人就展示了自己的空间装备！
不仅认识自己，还知道自己拥有的物品，现在连自己的能力都知道，明里暗里都在说，你有的，我都知道！
这个人太危险了，太有威胁了，有机会一定要除掉！
连续三条乐园提示从王长乐眼前闪过，不过对此，他早有预料，这还在他承受的范围之内。
“恐羊的皮如果用不完，也归你所有。
并且这些也归你所有”
王长乐看着脸色阴沉的能滴下水的叶钟鸣，知道现在要做的就是稳住对方的情绪。
话锋一转的同时，又从空间中又掏出2桶矿泉水，以及好几箱干脆面，还有一两只酒精消毒液。
这些东西对于王长乐而言，已经没有任何价值了。
但是对于还要在末日世界挣扎求存的叶钟鸣来说，干净的水源，充饥的干粮，以及消毒的酒精，都是不可或缺的物资。
听到王长乐的话，叶钟鸣的脸色稍缓，点了点头，让墨夜收起了物资，然后截取了三分之一的恐羊皮。
抬手光芒闪动，五件防爆服依次融合为一，深黑色防爆服肉眼可见的，变得更加紧实坚韧，还散发淡淡的灰色光芒。
紧接着，叶钟鸣连续捏碎10颗一级魔力结晶，补充了一下精神力，恐羊的尖角化作一道白光，没入防爆服内。
在白光的流动之间，防爆服的关节连接处，开始浮现出一道道骨骼的纹理，灰色微光，化作了白色的光纹。
短短十来分钟，五件防爆服就变成了一件白色的装备，不得不说世界之子的能力就是强大！
content_en:
,,!
Wang Changle put away the scroll, took out five pieces of standard explosion-proof armor, and took out a bottle of 1-star evolution potion and placed it on the ground.
Ye Zhongming had deeper doubts about Wang Changle. He could see that Wang Changle was telling the truth.
But there is no memory of this person in his mind. He does not know this person in his past life or in this life!
"Why should I trade with you? It's just a one-star evolution potion."
Xia Lei, Xiaohu couldn't help but be stunned when he heard these words.
What happened today? Not only did the precious evolution potion become the equivalent of the transaction, Ye Zhongming also said, "That's all."
You know, they also saw a violent fight between two groups last night over a bottle of evolution potion.
There were dozens of people killed and injured, but now they have become what others call "just"
"I definitely don't believe what others say, but I believe what Boss Ye says!
The one-star evolution potion is only part of the reward, the other part - I will answer you where I come from. "
Wang Changle laughed, but his expression was very calm.
The reason why he took out the one-star evolution potion was, firstly, because this evolution potion was only effective for the first time, and secondly, this thing could not be taken out of the world!
An evolutionary potion that was no longer effective for him and could not be taken out of the world had its natural value greatly reduced, so he chose to use it as a bargaining chip!
After all, this evolution potion is still very precious in the early stage and can be regarded as a good equivalent, especially for those who want to form a team.
As for Ye Zhongming, he is an out-and-out unstable factor!
Now that there was such an opportunity to get to know someone like Ye Zhongming, who had a strong desire for control and control, he guessed that the other party would not refuse.
After Wang Changle finished speaking, Ye Zhongming fell into silence, and the air suddenly became quiet.
Ten seconds later.
"Okay, I can make a deal with you. What do you want this time?"
Ye Zhongming nodded to Liang Chuyin and asked her to take Xia Lei Xiaohu and others out. Only Dihuang Wan and Mo Ye were left on the field.
"I need Boss Ye to help me refine a piece of equipment and use your homogeneous enhancement ability.
Based on these five explosion-proof suits, here are the other materials. "
Wang Changle watched Ye Zhongming retreating from the crowd, and immediately took out pieces of materials from the mark space, including the sharp horns of the fear sheep, a large piece of the skin of the fear sheep, and 10 magic crystals.
Ye Zhongming watched Wang Changle take out materials one after another, and his heart sank again. So many materials appeared in an instant. This is space equipment!
His heart sank. This person always seemed to be able to obtain the corresponding props before him. As soon as he obtained the space props, this man showed off his space equipment!
Not only do you know yourself, but you also know the items you own. Now you even know your abilities. You are saying openly and secretly, I know everything you have!
This person is too dangerous and threatening. We must get rid of him if we have the chance!
Three paradise prompts flashed in front of Wang Changle's eyes, but he had already expected this, and it was still within the range he could bear.
“If you can’t use up the skin of the fear sheep, it will be yours.
And these are yours too”
Wang Changle looked at Ye Zhongming, whose face was so gloomy that he could drip with tears, and knew that what he had to do now was to stabilize his mood.
As the conversation changed, he took out two more barrels of mineral water, several boxes of crispy noodles, and one or two alcohol disinfectants from the space.
These things no longer have any value to Wang Changle.
But for Ye Zhongming, who is still struggling to survive in the apocalyptic world, clean water, dry food to satisfy hunger, and alcohol for disinfection are all indispensable supplies.
Hearing Wang Changle's words, Ye Zhongming's face softened slightly, nodded, and asked Mo Ye to put away the supplies, and then intercepted one third of the sheepskin.
Raising his hand, light flashed, and the five pieces of explosion-proof clothing merged into one.Visibly to the naked eye, the black explosion-proof suit has become tighter and tougher, and it also emits a faint gray light.
Immediately afterwards, Ye Zhongming crushed 10 first-level magic crystals in succession to replenish his mental power. The sharp horns of the fear sheep turned into a white light and disappeared into the explosion-proof suit.
Between the flow of white light, the texture of bones began to appear at the joints of the explosion-proof suit, and the gray shimmer turned into white light patterns.
In just ten minutes, five explosion-proof suits turned into one piece of white equipment. It must be said that the ability of the Son of the World is powerful!
